# Compile half only. See notes.md "What cmd.txt can and cannot measure".
#
# This is the exact dxc invocation PixTest.cpp performs for
# PixTest::PixStructAnnotation_FloatN, with -Od replaced by -O1 as the issue
# instructs. Args come from PixTestUtils.cpp Compile() (/Zi /Qembed_debug
# prepended) plus TestStructAnnotationCase()'s -HV 2018 -enable-16bit-types,
# profile as_6_5, entry main.
#
# The reported symptom is NOT visible here: it appears only after the PIX
# optimizer pass -dxil-dbg-value-to-dbg-declare runs over this module, and
# dxc.exe cannot run PIX passes (dxopt.exe / IDxcOptimizer can). What this
# command establishes is the PRECONDITION for the bug: that -O1 hands the pass
# a pointer-typed llvm.dbg.value. See measure.py for the two-stage measurement
# that observes the actual symptom, and manual-case-release-history.txt for
# the result.
-T as_6_5 -E main /Zi /Qembed_debug -O1 -HV 2018 -enable-16bit-types repro.hlsl
